name: Ondas Holdings, Inc.
blurb: Ondas Holdings is an autonomous systems and drone technology company operating through two main segments: Ondas Autonomous Systems (drone and counter-drone platforms) and Ondas Networks (industrial wireless communications). Its Iron Drone Raider counter-UAS system and Optimus autonomous drone platforms serve defence, homeland security, and industrial customers in the US, Europe, Israel, and the UAE.
recent: Ondas delivered 605% revenue growth in 2025, with Q4 2025 revenue of $30.1 million — up 629% year-over-year. A pending $175 million merger with Mistral, a Bethesda, MD-based prime contractor with over $1 billion in existing DoD IDIQ (indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity) contracts, was announced. The company secured US border-security drone contracts. Stock rallied over 1,000% from 52-week lows, driven by defence-drone demand and the Mistral deal, before analysts cautioned on execution risk at elevated multiples.

sources.title: Ondas winning the drone wars in 2026 (Seeking Alpha)
